days.title: Historical Palaces and Natural Reserves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Palata Menasciutto
stops.detail: Two natural reserve areas have been identified within the park: that of Palata Menasciutto, in the Cremasco territory, and that of Malpaga-Basella, in the Bergamo territory.

stops.name: Villa Martini San Bernardino
stops.detail: Villa Martini San Bernardino in Crema, dating to the 16th century, has a very simple facade and is today part of the Oratory.

stops.name: Palazzo Benvenuti
stops.detail: Inside the Palazzo Benvenuti in Montodine, the border stone between the State of Milan and the State of Venice is preserved.

days.title: Castles and Estates of the Serio
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: castello di Malpaga
stops.detail: It is defined as a steppic and arid zone included between the Basella and the castle of Malpaga.

stops.name: castello di Cavernago
stops.detail: The list includes: the castle of Malpaga, the official residence of the Colleoni family; the castle of Cavernago, austere on the outside, but with richly frescoed rooms; the castle of Cologno al Serio and that of Martinengo, of which today only the tower remains with wall textures in river pebbles and solid bricks.

stops.name: Villa e Giardino Griffoni
stops.detail: Villa and Griffoni Garden in Castel Gabbiano, dating back to the end of the 17th century, are one of the first examples.
